summary: Implemented a pure deterministic planner that maps E1/E0 progress checks, E2 minimum current-scope evidence requests, and H1 or source-conflict review into the three legal ResolutionPath candidate types. The planner only plans tasks and never creates a replacement, refund, compensation, reshipment, ticket, or outbound message.
commit_message: feat(resolutions): plan scoped human-approved service paths
remaining_risks: Independent BATCH-16 verification has not been run.
BATCH-15 is consumed only as conditionally integrated backend rules; its independent acceptance remains FAIL as supplied by the task context.
No integration smoke test has been run.
handoff_notes: Consumers of plan_resolution must provide the same RuleEvaluation, PreparedAction, CaseInput, CommitmentCompilation, and (for E2) authoritative EvidenceAggregation.
The planner rejects unsupported rule/action combinations rather than fabricating a candidate type.
Consumer replies are rendered only from candidate type and allowlisted missing-coverage labels; never interpolate internal names, scores, ticket ids, model text, or time commitments.
VERIFICATION_REPORT.json was intentionally not created; it is owned by independent verification.
